title: Birthday Cake Blondies
changes_from_base: Vanilla and almond blondie batter studded with rainbow sprinkles.
summary: Vanilla and almond blondies speckled with rainbow sprinkles.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Line a 20 cm tin with baking paper and heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Sugars
steps.text: Stir both sugars, the vanilla, salt and almond flavouring together in a bowl.

steps.title: Butter
steps.text: Melt the butter, pour it over the sugars and stir well, then beat in the eggs until glossy.

steps.title: Flour
steps.text: Fold in the flour and baking powder, then two-thirds of the sprinkles. Spread in the tin and scatter the rest of the sprinkles on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 25-30 min, until golden at the edges and set in the middle.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool fully in the tin and cut into 16.

tips: Long rainbow sprinkles hold their colour better than tiny balls.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
